changes.old_value: Theories do not arrive fully formed from the heavens. They are constructed — assembled piece by piece through specific intellectual moves, borrowings, translations, and justifications. Yet most readers encounter theories as finished products, evaluating whether they agree with the conclusions while remaining blind to how the theoretical edifice was built. changes.new_value: A construction ledger: problem and scope → inputs → move → resulting concept or mechanism → warrant → limit. Lead with how the text earns its proposed contribution, distinguishing claimed novelty from demonstrated work. Desks lift construction moves and theory–evidence articulation tables; a well-supported inventory is sufficient. Text proposing, revising or combining theory; empirical measures only where empirical claims are undertaken.
